sleep-sounds.title: Brown Noise for Sleep (10 min)
sleep-sounds.desc: Deep, steady brown noise to mask room sounds while you fall asleep.

sleep-sounds.title: Gentle Rain for Sleep (10 min)
sleep-sounds.desc: Soft rain on a quiet night. No thunder, no music.

sleep-sounds.title: Ocean Waves for Sleep (10 min)
sleep-sounds.desc: Slow, rolling waves, roughly one every nine seconds, to breathe along with.

sleep-sounds.title: Box Fan Sound (10 min)
sleep-sounds.desc: The steady hum of a box fan, for people who can't sleep without one.

sleep-sounds.title: Night Bells over Brown Noise (10 min)
sleep-sounds.desc: Very soft, far-apart bells over a low brown-noise bed. A wind-down, not an alarm.

focus-sounds.title: 10-Minute Focus Sprint: Brown Noise
focus-sounds.desc: One bell to start, three bells to stop. Pick one task and stay on it until the bells.

focus-sounds.title: 10-Minute Focus Sprint: Pink Noise
focus-sounds.desc: Brighter than brown noise, good for covering office chatter.

focus-sounds.title: 10-Minute Focus Sprint: Rain
focus-sounds.desc: Rain on the window and one job to finish before the bells.

focus-sounds.title: 10-Minute Focus Sprint with Minute Markers
focus-sounds.desc: A soft tick every minute so you always know where you are. Great for timed work or study.

focus-sounds.title: 10-Minute Study Session: Ocean
focus-sounds.desc: Slow waves as a steady background for reading or revision.
